content.title: Hotel Packages - Weekend 2 | Coachella
content.text: Weekend 2 Hotel Packages Leave the planning to VMT with our Curated Hotel Packages bundling GA or VIP festival access with local resort and hotel accommodations and Shuttle Passes for your group. SOLD OUT GA Packages GA Hotel Package | 3-Night | Weekend 2 Getting Your PassesPlease note: When a Hotel Package is purchased close to the start of the event, the wristbands and shuttle passes in your order will be automatically set to Will Call Pickup. Passes must be picked up from the festival Box Office at Indian Wells Tennis GardenBox Office & Will Call information can be found HERE. Pricing & Payment PlansAll taxes, services fees, and shipping fees are included in your package price.Payment Plans are no longer available for hotel packages.If you've previously opted into a payment plan, please see below for payment plan information:If payment on an installment fails, your card will automatically be charged again 7 days later. If that second attempted charge fails, you will be automatically charged 7 days after that. If that third attempted charge fails, your order will be cancelled.Defaulted Hotel Package Payment Plans will result in cancellation of package and are subject to a $50 per item re-stocking fee. No exceptions. It is your responsibility to manage your payment plan and to check your credit card and bank statements for charges. To update your payment method, please log into your EASOL account HERE.Important Info to Know Before You BookSee HERE for full Hotel Package FAQsAll orders are non-refundable and non-transferable, per our purchase policy. 3 Night Packages check-in on the Friday of each weekend and Four Night Packages check-in on the Thursday of each weekend.For Hotel Package guests, event wristbands and Coachella Shuttle passes will be mailed to you by AXS in advance closer to the event date.If you cannot attend the event or if you purchased as a gift: please note, hotel name changes may be authorized for free through Wednesday, February 11, 2026. There will be a $100 fee for adding a hotel name change after this date. Name changes can be processed in advance through Valley Music Travel up to 2 weeks prior to the event date. After Friday, March 27th, for Weekend One and Friday, April 3rd for Weekend Two, no alternate pick-ups will be allowed. The Coachella Shuttle pick-up/drop off zones will be at convenient locations in the valley; however, the shuttle is not guaranteed to pick-up directly from your hotel and you may need to walk or rideshare to the closest shuttle stop. Exact locations will be provided as we get closer to the festival lineup announcement.Select hotels are 21+, please check your specific package details before purchasing. Included: Check In Thursday April 16th | Check Out Monday April 20th 3-Day VIP Coachella Weekend Two passes for your group Coachella Shuttle passes for your group Indio Hotels Fairfield Inn & Suites Indio-Coachella Valley Make Fairfield Inn Indio your home for Coachella and enjoy a free hot breakfast buffet each day. Hampton Inn & Suites Indio Experience convenience at the perfect location near the festival for your fun filled weekend. La Quinta Hotels La Quinta Resort & Club Discover desert luxury —lush gardens, cozy casitas, a spa, and seven dining experiences. Embassy Suites by Hilton La Quinta Hotel & Spa This 4-star hotel sits right in the heart of the Coachella Valley. Homewood Suites by Hilton La Quinta Enjoy renovated suites, golf, dining, free breakfast, pool, and fitness center. Indian Wells Hotels Renaissance Esmeralda Resort & Spa Indian Wells Set within the beautiful Coachella Valley, this is a true desert oasis. Tommy Bahama Miramonte Resort & Spa Escape to luxury —11 acres of citrus trees, lush gardens, and island-inspired rooms. Palm Desert Hotels Courtyard Palm Desert Enjoy mountain views, boutique hotel vibes, and budget-friendly comfort in a desert oasis. Embassy Suites by Hilton Palm Desert Stay near Indian Wells with a resort-style pool, daily breakfast & a complimentary evening reception! Hampton Inn & Suites Palm Desert Stay near nature —comfy rooms, free hot breakfast & a relaxing stay just minutes from Coachella! Homewood Suites by Hilton Palm Desert Comfort, convenience, and relaxation—your perfect stay in Palm Desert, just minutes from Coachella. Holiday Inn Express & Suites Palm Desert - Millennium Enjoy the perfect Palm Desert getaway with a relaxing pool near golf, shopping, and Coachella. JW Marriott Desert Springs Resort & Spa Escape to luxury with five pools, championship golf, a world-class spa, and exquisite dining. Residence Inn Palm Desert Stay at Residence Inn Palm Desert—a pool, tennis courts, breakfast, and a new fitness center! Palm Springs & Rancho Mirage Hotels Hilton Garden Inn Palm Springs/Rancho Mirage Dine & shop at The River Mall. Enjoy the pool and fitness center. Close to PSP airport too! Hilton Palm Springs Relax with a fitness center, spa, outdoor pool, and cocktails with mountain views. Omni Rancho Las Palmas Resort & Spa Relax in 240 acres of pools, spa, and fitness center, set against stunning desert mountain views. Renaissance Palm Springs Hotel Experience desert luxury —soak up the sun by the city’s largest pool or unwind in a private cabana. The Westin Rancho Mirage Golf Resort & Spa Lounge by three pools, soak in mountain views, or tee off on a championship golf course.
